summary: Phase 5 Agent Portal tested end-to-end. Backend: all 24 new pytest cases pass (RBAC 401/403, dashboard, published-only catalog, search, draft 404, markup set/update/persist with retail = net + markup, audit log agent.markup.set, 400 outside bounds / 422 negative, admin narrows max to 1000 so existing 2000 markup becomes out_of_range/bookable=false and then fixed at 800, cross-key min<=max rule, fund requests bounds 400/422, admin queue visibility, 409 at 5 pending, ledger totals exclude cancelled with earned=0, transactions, profile PATCH only changes phone/address and enforces max length). Frontend: agent login goes to /agent; dashboard stats, markup alert and quick links work; catalog Set markup dialog shows the inline range error, disables Save and shows the live customer price preview (3500+1234=4734); the save updates the card; All/Ready/Needs markup filters, search with empty state, and the detail page all work; Customer view toggle (header, dashboard and mobile) masks values with •••• and hides markup buttons, the toggles stay in sync and the setting survives a reload (localStorage). Top-up dialog validation and submit work, Ledger Earnings/Wallet tabs and the 7 spec columns are correct, profile save persists, the password-mismatch check and wrong-current-password error toast work (demo password NOT changed). Admin Settings markup cards render and the cross-key error toast shows. Mobile 390px is mostly fine. Cleanup done: TEST_P5 fund requests and markups deleted, markup settings are 0.00/10000.00, demo phone restored, pending fund requests back to 1.

minor.issue: The pending-count check and the insert are separate steps (race), so two requests sent at the same moment could create a 6th pending request. Low risk.
The audit 'before' payload leaves out package_id (only 'after' has it). Small inconsistency for audit consumers.

ui_bugs.issue: Long email 'agent.demo@biyahetabai.example.com' overflows into the 'Member since' column and the text overlaps. Add break-all/truncate or min-w-0, or change the grid split.
The page scrolls sideways a little (document scrollWidth 404 > 390). Other agent pages are 390.

issues: Dashboard quick link still says 'Set your markup (₱0.00–₱10000.00 per pax)' and the amber markup alert ('4 of 5 packages can't be sold yet — set or fix your markup') still shows. This tells customers about markups. Hide both, or reword them, when hidden=true.
Top-ups page amounts are not masked in Customer view. Consider masking them because they reveal funding/balance info.
'Not available' is text-stone-400 in the display font at text-sm. Contrast is low and it is hard to read.
Bounds are shown raw (₱0.00–₱10000.00) while the rest of the app uses formatPHP (₱0 – ₱10,000). Inconsistent.
The ledger table scrolls sideways inside its card with no visual hint. Net cost/Customer paid/Earned are off-screen at 390px. Consider a stacked card layout like the Top-ups page.
The '4D3N Cebu Free & Easy' cover image looks like the Ho Chi Minh City skyline (Bitexco tower), not Cebu.

action_items: Fix profile header email overflow/overlap with the Member since column
Fix the 14px sideways scroll on the mobile agent dashboard
In Customer view, hide the markup alert and the quick-link markup-bounds text (and consider masking top-up amounts)
Improve contrast of the 'Not available' label in Customer view retail display
Optional: format quick-link bounds with formatPHP; use a mobile-friendly ledger layout; replace the Cebu cover image
critical_code_review_comments: agent.py: isolation via current_agent from the JWT is solid; no agent_id is taken from the client.
agent.py create_fund_request: the max-5-pending check is not atomic (count then insert).
agent.py list_packages imports re inside the function; move it to module level.

MarkupDialog: front-end validation uses parseFloat and the backend re-validates with Decimal, so this is fine. The `pkg?.markup_amount ?` check treats '0.00' as truthy (string), so 0 markups display correctly.
PrivacyContext: localStorage key btb-agent-privacy-mode persists correctly; the provider is created per route, which is fine because state is read from localStorage on mount.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows functional; 2 minor UI bugs, privacy-mode leaks)
